message.content:
This vertical rectangular illustration is a magazine cover with a bright red background. At the top, the white word "TEMPO" is centered in large, bold, sans-serif letters. Above it, three headlines in white text are separated by diagonal lines: "MAIN SETRUM DAHLAN ISKAN", "AHOK: GUE INGIN JADI PRESIDEN", and "KONTROVERSI PASAL ABORSI". Below the main title, "25-31 AGUSTUS 2014" appears in small white text.

The central figure consists of a white, long-sleeved button-up shirt with four front pockets and a red bird emblem on the right chest. The shirt, featuring a purple sash around the waist, is filled as if by an invisible torso. A single right arm in the same white sleeve extends upward, ending in a gloved white hand performing a salute. Above the empty neck collar, a black songkok hat floats in the air, positioned near the saluting hand. Tucked into the purple sash is a traditional kris dagger with a brown, curved hilt.

In the bottom left, large black text reads "UJUNG SEBUAH DRAMA". Below that, white text lists "RP 35.000", "WWW.TEMPO.CO", "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN", and "ISSN: 0126 - 4273" above a barcode.
